topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Well, I ain't surprised. Not one bit. Knew this day was coming the moment they painted over the chipped old sign. See, in this town, everything's for sale, and your building's no different. They come in, shiny-tongued and slick, with promises of fresh starts and new opportunities. But what I see? I see the same old game, just with fancier cards. You think they're offering a slice of paradise? Let me tell you, it’s just a different kind of rent. One where you pay for the privilege of thinking you own a piece of the rock. But I know better. You want to play this game, you gotta keep your eyes open and your pockets closed. I’ve seen this road before. And I'm still standing.
